# Dora

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dora is characterized by her gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and long, sleek curls that always remain neatly in place. She maintains a proper and tidy appearance, often seen wearing a nicely starched white dress paired with a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a neat, faithful, and exceptionally observant child who quickly learns her tasks and remembers her duties without needing repetition. Unfailingly prim, proper, and demure, she is exceptionally well-behaved, usually speaking only when addressed and acting as a model child. She approaches her work industriously, systematically, and dispassionately, finding happiness in helping with tasks suited to her size. While her calm, composed, and quiet nature can make her seem somewhat monotonous, she is recognized as a good and lovely child. Despite her usual composure, she harbours a specific fear regarding [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's deceased uncle.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +8 more_

## History

Dora and her twin brother, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), were orphaned following the terminal illness of their mother's cousin, Mary Keith, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to bring them to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Dora soon faced various misadventures caused by her brother, including being forced to walk a pigpen fence into ruin, being pumped with water, and later being locked inside Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). While living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she was comforted by [Anne](../character/anne.md) after being frightened at school by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about deceased relatives. Following the death of [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), a trust fund was established that permanently secured Dora's and Davy's home with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md).

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P6](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0006), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P9](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0009), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P10](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0010), +349 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--dora.md)

Dora comes under Anne's care alongside her twin brother after being orphaned. [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps raise and educate her, assisting with her sewing and looking after her daily needs. Unlike her brother [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), Dora causes little trouble for [Anne](../character/anne.md), though she occasionally requires rescuing from her brother's practical jokes.

- Student of — teacher helping to bring her up  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030)</sub>

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is Dora's twin brother. Their relationship is characterized by Davy's mischievous targeting of Dora, such as ruining her dress by forcing her to walk a pigpen fence and pumping water over her. On another occasion, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) locks Dora in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and lies about her whereabouts, causing a widespread search before she is found.

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P51](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0051), +5 more</sub>

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--irving.md)

Dora is acquainted with [Irving](../character/irving.md) during her childhood.

- Friend of — childhood acquaintance  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Dora's third cousin who takes Dora and her twin brother into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following the death of their mother, Mary Keith. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) acts as a guardian and caretaker, bringing Dora to live with her and managing the challenges of raising the young orphaned twins.

- Comrade of — traveling companion to town  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001)</sub>
